title: AIA fetch loop: no aggregate byte cap
description: build_with_aia (pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:595-721) fetches intermediates via AIA caIssuers URIs and adds them to a CertPool. Bounded by AIA_MAX_DEPTH=5 iterations but no aggregate byte cap. What goes wrong (availability): memory growth from attacker-controlled AIA chains. Location: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs lines 607-700. Fix: aggregate byte counter in the loop.
